mentions.name: Tensou
mentions.description: A cross-platform local file transfer tool that supports transfer resumes, folder syncing similar to rsync, and performance on par with or better than Dukto for large files, with ongoing optimizations for small files and mobile support planned. Built as an alternative to Dukto and LocalSend without their compromises.
mentions.problem: Existing local file transfer tools are frustrating: Dukto is tiring to run cross platform and lacks transfer resume support (a cancelled copy at 99% must be redone or manually diffed), while LocalSend doesn't work when connecting two devices over a LAN cable and has poor resume support.
